name: Homelabarr
subtitle: Self-hosted *arr media manager with native Prowlarr Interactive Search
description: Homelabarr is a custom iOS fork of LunaSea featuring native Prowlarr Interactive Search inside Radarr & Sonarr, live Quality Profile & Blocklist verification, 4 live themes with matching native iOS alternate app icons, and a guided First-Time Setup Walkthrough.

apps.name: Homelabarr
apps.subtitle: Self-hosted *arr companion with Prowlarr Interactive Search
apps.localizedDescription:
Manage Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, NZBGet, SABnzbd, Lidarr, Tautulli, and Overseerr from a clean, themeable iOS app.

• Inline Prowlarr Interactive Search inside Radarr & Sonarr
• Live Quality Profile & Blocklist checking with automatic sorting
• Smart release age display (hours/minutes when under 1 day)
• 4 live themes (Forest Sage, Midnight Ocean, Obsidian Gold, Crimson Noir) with matching native iOS alternate app icons
• Guided First-Time Setup Walkthrough with Skip on every step
• 100% local, zero telemetry, GPL-3.0 open source

versions.localizedDescription: Adds qBittorrent, Transmission & Deluge torrent clients, multi-downloader Prowlarr Search (NZBGet/SABnzbd/Torrents), Overseerr/Jellyseerr, standalone Prowlarr, Bazarr with Search All Missing, 4 Dashboard layouts (Stacked, 2-Col Grid, 3-Col Grid, Grouped), and usage-grouped Setup Walkthrough.

Initial public blank-slate release with native Prowlarr Interactive Search, live Quality Profile & Blocklist verification, 4 live themes with matching iOS app icons, smart release age formatting, and guided First-Time Setup Walkthrough.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Homelabarr connects to your self-hosted media servers on your local network.
